headword: {超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル

definitions.explanation: An extremely tall building, typically over 100 meters or roughly 20 stories or more. The term specifically refers to buildings that tower above the surrounding cityscape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新宿|しんじゅく}→新宿：30634_shinjuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many skyscrapers in Shinjuku.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地上|ちじょう}→地上：12108_chijou⟧60⟦{階建|かいだ}て→階建て：29226_kaidate⟧だ。

⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}{中|ちゅう}→建設中：22326_kensetsuchuu⟧で、⟦{完成|かんせい}すれば→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A new skyscraper is under construction in front of the station, and once completed it will be the tallest building in this area.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧ (super, ultra), ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧ (high-rise), and ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧ (building). In Japan, buildings over about 60 meters (roughly 20 stories) are generally classified as ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}→超高層：26197_choukousou⟧. Japan's tallest building is {麻布台|あざぶだい}ヒルズ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧JP⟦タワー→タワー：11035_tawaa⟧ at 330 meters.

- {超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧: a skyscraper is built
- {超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧: a cluster of skyscrapers
- ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}→超高層：26197_choukousou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: super high-rise apartment building
- {超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧: observation deck of a skyscraper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高層|こうそう}ビル→高層ビル：16994_kousoubiru⟧: high-rise building — tall but not as extreme as ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}→超高層：26197_choukousou⟧
